notes: Read src/fares.ts and test/fares.test.ts to ground the review. The code has three fare paths: hasPass→0, age≥65→concession, age<13→concession, else base. The original AC 'The existing fare behaviour for children, pass holders and adults is unchanged' was too vague — it bundled three distinct categories into one untestable blanket statement. I decomposed it into four specific observable sub-cases (ACs 4–7) that each assert a concrete fare value for a concrete rider. I also added AC 3 (age 66) to confirm the senior boundary works above the fix point, and ACs 7–8 to cover the pass-priority interaction at both boundary ages (65 and 12), since the hasPass check short-circuits before the age checks and a regression could silently break that priority. No splitting proposed — that is openspec's decision alone.
